meta.title: Magnetic Field Strength Converter — Convert Ampere/meter and More
meta.description: Free magnetic field strength converter for 3+ units including Ampere/meter, Ampere/centimeter, Oersted. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: A/m, oersted. Convert between 3 magnetic field strength units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for magnetic field strength in this tool is **Am**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most magnetic field strength conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Ampere/meter | A/m |
| Ampere/centimeter | A/cm |
| Oersted | Oe |
content.use_cases:
- MRI, NMR, and scientific-instrument field strength.
- Magnet selection for industrial holding applications.
- Sensor calibration in gauss vs tesla.
- Audio and speaker magnet specs.
- Magnetic shielding design.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this magnetic field strength converter?
**A:** It uses 3 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Ampere/meter (A/m), Ampere/centimeter (A/cm), Oersted (Oe).
